text: hey everybody whenever anyone says the Bible says this or the Bible says that keep in mind the Bible doesn't say anything at all because it's just a text
it cannot speak and it certainly cannot confirm or deny or correct the meanings that are attributed to it so when people
say the Bible says this or that they're saying this is the meaning that I am constructing with the text it is always
a process of negotiation and in that process of negotiation we're going to fall somewhere along a spectrum on one side of that Spectrum we have people who
are disciplined and informed and are trying to construct a meaning that we believe is most likely to be the meaning
that best served the needs and the interests and the circumstances of the original authors and audiences on the other side of the spectrum we have
people who are less disciplined and less informed who are going to try to construct a meaning that best serves
their own needs and interests and circumstances and so when people say the Bible says X and the Bible says Y and X
and Y happen to fit into a consistent and convenient and systematic worldview that happens to be very relevant to
today they are on this side of the spectrum
